tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The canvas. Every screen, the log and the list sit straight on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: write blocks, the brief, picks, metrics, menus, the command line, and the band behind your own log lines.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows, tag fills, meter tracks, the held-write header strip and poster placeholders.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Wells for typing: inputs, selects and the command line's field.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: row dividers, panel edges, the tab rail. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that identify a control (inputs, selects, secondary buttons, toggles) and outlined aired-but-unwatched episode cells. 3:1 on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind the chat drawer on phones. Solid, never blurred.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and show titles on bg, surface and surface-raised (13:1 and up). Also the focus ring.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: meta lines, kurisu's tool output summaries, inactive tabs. On bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, run metadata, counts, placeholders, the /10 after a score. 4.7:1 on every ground. Also the Dropped status.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Crimson, the primary accent. Fills only: primary buttons, progress fills, watched episode cells, the active tab and nav marker, the new-episode flag. Text on it uses on-accent. 3.3:1 on bg as a mark.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Crimson as text or icon: the › prompt glyph, Undo and other action links, "out today", errors. Derived from accent for legibility, 6.5:1 on bg and 5.9:1 on surface; #b7323b as text is only 3.2:1.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of an error banner and of a facet menu that is filtering.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (5.5:1).

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Teal, the secondary accent: success and proposals. The dashed border of every MAL write, the Watching status, taste-up bars. 7:1 on surface as text.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the held-write header strip and of a Watching badge.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a signal fill (7.7:1).

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Ochre: the On hold status and warnings (re-login needed). Text on bg and surface.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a warning banner and an On hold badge.

tokens.name: status-watching
tokens.usage: Watching: square mark, glyph and word.

tokens.name: status-completed
tokens.usage: Completed: square mark, glyph and word. 6.4:1 on surface.

tokens.name: status-completed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Completed badge.

tokens.name: status-on-hold
tokens.usage: On hold: square mark, glyph and word.

tokens.name: status-dropped
tokens.usage: Dropped: deliberately the faintest status, with its slashed glyph and word.

tokens.name: status-planned
tokens.usage: Plan to watch: a cool slate, quiet like a backlog. 7:1 on surface.

tokens.name: status-planned-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of a Plan to watch or Dropped badge.

tokens.name: taste-up
tokens.usage: Genres you rate above your average. Bars grow right of the centre line and carry a + value.

tokens.name: taste-down
tokens.usage: Genres you rate below your average. Bars grow left and carry a − value; direction and sign, not hue alone, tell them apart.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and destructive hovers.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline, offset 2px. 13:1 on every ground.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The wordmark: the login screen and the cover. Nowhere else.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles: My list, Taste, History, Brief.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section headers, empty-state titles and the brief's summary line.

styles.name: show-title
styles.usage: Show titles in rows, write blocks, picks, the brief and drop reasons. One line, truncated.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Done. Tidewater is on ep 7 of 12.
styles.usage: Log lines, kurisu's replies, a pick's reason, banner text.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Meta lines under titles, hints under fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels, action links.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase: status badges, log levels (WRITE, HELD, WARN, ERR), section labels. Set in caps in the markup or with text-transform.

styles.name: data-xl
styles.usage: One hero metric a screen: the Taste average. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), so columns line up.

styles.name: data-lg
styles.usage: Values in a metrics strip. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), so columns line up.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Episode readouts, scores, tab counts, diffs (ep 6 → 7). Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), so columns line up.

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Timestamps, countdowns, counts, chart labels and status lines. Tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums), so columns line up.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: What the agent itself prints: RunMeta, the tool trace and proposal ids. Nowhere else.

spacing.note: Strict 8px grid. Padding is only space-8, space-16 or space-24. Larger steps are for gaps between sections. Hairlines (1px), the focus outline (2px) and meters (4px) are strokes, not spacing.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Padding inside rows, tags, badges and write blocks; the gap between an icon and its label, and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding, the phone side gutter, the gap between a poster and its text, between log entries.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Padding of hero panels (metrics, the empty state) and the gap between sections inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Gap above a screen's first section. Layout only, never padding.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Login screen spacing. Layout only.

tokens.name: space-64
tokens.usage: Bottom clearance for the nav on scrolling screens. Layout only.

radius.note: Crisp corners only. Nothing is a pill or a circle.

tokens.name: radius-4
tokens.usage: Controls, tags, badges, posters, keycaps and toggles.

tokens.name: radius-6
tokens.usage: Panels: write blocks, the brief, picks, metrics, banners, menus and the notification. The maximum anywhere.

tokens.name: control-24
tokens.usage: Tags, badges, keycaps, the tiny icon buttons on chat rows.

tokens.name: control-32
tokens.usage: The default control: buttons, inputs, selects, filter menus, toggles, the send button.

tokens.name: control-40
tokens.usage: Tabs and the one login button.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch height: list rows, chat rows, nav items, and the invisible hit area around small and icon buttons.

tokens.name: poster-sm
tokens.usage: Poster width in log lines, write blocks, list rows and the brief (32 × 48).

tokens.name: poster-md
tokens.usage: Poster width in picks (64 × 96).

tokens.name: poster-lg
tokens.usage: Minimum poster width in the grid view (96 × 144).

tokens.name: meter-height
tokens.usage: Progress bars and episode cells.

tokens.name: log-gutter
tokens.usage: The timestamp column of the log and the change log: HH:MM:SS in data-sm plus its 16px inset.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom nav height on phones, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the log and the list.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: The chat list on wide screens.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The nav rail on screens 1024px and up: an icon over its label, full height on the left.

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a Sheet from 640px up. On phones a sheet is full width.

meta.note: v4: four screens (Today, List, Chat, You) with a nav rail from 1024px; Sheet, Toast, ShowHero, EpisodeRow and WelcomeStep; 48px touch targets for small and icon buttons. v3: Inter for words and numbers (tabular), Source Serif 4 for show and screen titles, JetBrains Mono only for the machine. v2: strict dark identity, 8px grid, crisp corners, chat as a command log.
